stops.title: Welcome to Ashik's Home
stops.text: Stone, teak and a terracotta jali under the overhanging roofs.

stops.title: Sit Out
stops.text: A deep white portal with two rattan chairs beside the teak main door.

stops.title: Living
stops.text: Double-height living: look up at the crystal chandelier in the cutout.

stops.title: Dining
stops.text: Six-seat dining, open to the passage, with the jali screen outside the window.

stops.title: Kitchen
stops.text: L-shaped counter along the window walls, with the work area behind.

stops.title: Guest Bedroom
stops.text: Bed against the back wall under the window, wardrobe on the right.

stops.title: Passage
stops.text: The 1.2 m passage opens through sliding glass onto the courtyard.

stops.title: Staircase
stops.text: Up the right flight to the landing, then back along the left.

stops.title: First-floor Passage
stops.text: Overlooks the double-height cutout and the chandelier.

stops.title: Bedroom 1
stops.text: Headboard under a high window, study desk on the right, wardrobe by the door.

stops.title: Bedroom 3
stops.text: Box window to the front, tall wardrobe and a desk, attached toilet behind.

stops.title: Master Bedroom
stops.text: Walk-in wardrobe and toilet behind, sliding doors out to the balcony.

stops.title: Balcony
stops.text: Teak soffit, glass railing and the evening view over the garden.
